box: Jetson Orin Nano Super, Ubuntu 24.04.5 aarch64, 6 cores, 7.5 GB RAM

bridge.act_note: an act is a real walk across the room at 2 cells/tick; a refused or short step answers in ~0.2 s (one poll cycle)
bridge.engine_link: file IPC in the world dir (atomic tmp+rename both ways); this Luanti build never delivers fetch_async or emerge_area callbacks with no clients connected (receipted in ENGINE-ON-ORIN.md)
bridge.smoke: PASS — locked attempt stays with event 'The gate is locked.'; brass key auto-taken in the warehouse; gate opens with 'The brass key turns; the gate swings open.'; treasure in the lighthouse; nonsense verb answered

desk_impact: Engine + bridge resident ~61 MB RSS total; box RAM flat at ~4.9/7.5 GB through play; no farm or desktop process touched, nothing installed system-wide (~/engine-arena/ only), no farm.json/FARM.md edits. The field is up now and answers on 127.0.0.1:8797.

luanti.round_trip: file IPC ~0.15 s poll + the walk (see smoke)

engine_chosen.name: Luanti (Minetest) 5.6.1 dedicated server
engine_chosen.why: Only candidate whose headless server is the product itself: boots to a listening voxel server in ~1 s at ~30 MB idle RSS, with total Lua control over generated content. Godot 4.3 headless answered TCP round trips faster (median 47.9 ms) but is an editor binary running a project — 3.5x the disk, 2.7x the idle RAM, and far more code between the framework and a checkable place. Both test installs remain on the box in user space.

open_items: Farm registration is PROPOSED only (proposed-farm-registration.md) — the referee merges it; note the one honest cost: a `world` member is resident, where the farm's pattern is spawn-per-call.

The 3-way merge is a perception-design datum, not an engine defect: radius-6 kind-counts alias timber-floored rooms. A sharper signature (kind counts weighted, or contents/landmark kinds) is the named next experiment, not a silent fix.
Signature previews (`through`) are computed at the destination standpoint; the chapel's closed door and the locked gate correctly preview as None.

play.evidence_file: play_results.json (per-step signature/truth pairs for all 255 steps)
play.player: the liquid framework itself — LiquidModel + ExplorerPolicy, unmodified, through observe/act alone (lwm copied to the Orin; adapter mirrors agent_view/scorer_truth discipline)
play.reading: Day 1 is a clean sweep (all six regions, chapel included, treasure in 15 steps). Days 2-3 the explorer ping-pongs warehouse/quay/boathouse for 120 steps: the three regions share one signature, so the chart holds them as ONE place with unioned exits, and every crossing contradicts a belief (330 surprises/day). Perceptual aliasing — the THOR-TEST twins problem at three-way strength — reproduced inside a real engine, from receipts (full step log in play_results.json).
